title: Alert-budget evaluation for collusion detectors
description: Existing collusion detectors rarely report recall at fixed false-positive alert budgets for analyst review.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: Closest work either benchmarks collusion broadly or studies abstention outside collusion.
minimum_experiment_needed: Compare collusion detectors at matched false-positive alert budgets.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: A specialized fraud detection benchmark may already include this setting.

title: Deployment validity for synthetic collusion labels
